lanes.summary: The app cannot open without a connection; the observed signed-in home is the Diary ("TODAY"), but whether a relaunch restores the last tab or screen was not observed.
Lifesum sends reminders and keeps an in-app "Messages" inbox behind the bell icon, but where a push tap lands (and when signed out) was not observed or documented.

lanes.summary: Reminders are configured in-app and Apple Health is opt-in from Automatic Tracking; when permissions are off, the help center sends users to iOS Settings or the Health app by hand. No in-app Settings link was found.
sources: Mobbin flow 357f31bd-89bb-4eca-87a0-29e4516bdf38 (Settings: Notification Settings, Automatic Tracking; screen c7c496e0-364e-4412-8206-848b30d0f3d0)

lanes.summary: Paywall with Restore Purchase and Redeem Code, a spinner during purchase, then the Diary; failures are handled only in the help center (contact support or buy on the web), and Ask to Buy/pending was not found.
sources: Mobbin flow ec0bd58b-d395-4c7f-8c0c-d9be3c588309 (Subscribing to Lifesum Premium)

lanes.summary: A lapsed Premium drops gently to the free version with all data kept on the server and favorites still viewable; grace-period messaging was not found, and the app only shows the last 30 days of tracked data.

Account-based: log in with Apple, Google, Email or Facebook brings the data back; Restore Purchase is on the paywall and in Settings. The common failure is signing in with a different method than the one that holds the subscription.

In-app Settings > Account Settings > Delete account, a pop-up, then a typed confirmation code, then the signed-out welcome screen; the help center (not the screen) warns that the subscription is not cancelled.
steps: "This is the start of life improving"

lanes.summary: Help center: "Unfortunately not." The app can't open offline, and if the connection drops while it's open you can view but not save or track.
No version What's New sheet found; new features show up as dismissible in-place cards ("Try AI food tracking" ×) and in the Messages inbox, with a running changelog in the help center.
steps: "updates in the app", expire in 3-7 days
sources: Mobbin flow ec0bd58b-d395-4c7f-8c0c-d9be3c588309 (Diary with "Try AI food tracking" card)

lanes.summary: AI Tracking is labelled Premium-only, and Lifesum's support bot asks whether users are "receiving an error message in the AI Chat", so AI errors exist, but their copy, retry and whether typed or photographed input survives were not observed; offline, nothing can be saved.
sources: Mobbin screen b66c0f06-c81a-4a30-87d0-c66c66800735 (support chat: "receiving an error message in the AI Chat")

lanes.summary: Account Settings has a "Data Consents" row and the policy says consents can be withdrawn there; AI Tracking is offered as the default only after a question on first use; but the in-app support chat's data consent says revoking it means emailing contact@lifesum.com, harder than giving it.

lanes.summary: Log-in offers Apple, Google, Email or Facebook, and the help center explains the "email address is already connected" pop-up (you were on sign-up, choose Log in); Settings > LOG OUT has no confirm, shows "Logging out" and lands on the welcome screen, which then asks "Is this you?" with the old email. Cancelled sign-in not observed.

lanes.summary: The help center says using several devices is "not something that we fully support" (entries may not appear on the other device) and meals can't be shared with other users; the Apple Watch app picks up the iPhone's login.
steps: Same method that holds the data
Login passed from the iPhone app
Triggers sync if Watch is signed out
